title: Performance uncertainty in medical image analysis: a large-scale investigation of confidence intervals
abstract: Performance uncertainty quantification is essential for reliable validation and eventual clinical translation of medical imaging artificial intelligence (AI). Confidence intervals (CIs) play a central role in this process by indicating how precise a reported performance estimate is. Yet, due to the limited amount of work examining CI behavior in medical imaging, the community remains largely unaware of how many diverse CI methods exist and how they behave in specific settings. The purpose of this study is to close this gap. To this end, we conducted a large-scale empirical analysis across a total of 24 segmentation and classification tasks, using 19 trained models per task group, a broad spectrum of commonly used performance metrics, multiple aggregation strategies, and several widely adopted CI methods. Reliability (coverage) and precision (width) of each CI method were estimated across all settings to characterize their dependence on study characteristics. Our analysis revealed five principal findings: (1) the sample size required for reliable CIs varies from a few dozens to several thousands of cases depending on study parameters; (2) CI behavior is strongly affected by the choice of performance metric; (3) aggregation strategy substantially influences the reliability of CIs, e.g. they require more observations for macro than for micro; (4) the machine learning problem (segmentation versus classification) modulates these effects; (5) different CI methods are not equally reliable and precise depending on the use case. Finally, we derived practical implications of this study in the form of a decision tree which shall prove useful to the community. This paves the way for future consensus guidelines on reporting performance uncertainty.
takeaway: 신뢰구간이 믿을 만해지는 데 필요한 표본 수는 지표·집계 방식·과제에 따라 수십 건에서 수천 건까지 크게 달라지며, 이를 고르는 의사결정 트리를 제시한다.
relevance: 우리 코호트는 흉부 X선 272건에 48가지 라벨 조합이 있고 정상 145건, 침윤 21건, 결절 7건, 섬유화 6건처럼 이상 소견 클래스가 매우 작아, 클래스별 성능을 추정할 때 신뢰구간 폭과 신뢰성이 문제가 되는 상황입니다. 이 논문의 macro/micro 집계 차이 논의가 이런 희소 라벨 평가에 직접 맞물립니다.
caveat: 방법론 연구로 환자 코호트에 대한 임상 결과나 판독자 연구가 없으며, 흉부 X선 다중 라벨 과제가 분석된 24개 과제에 포함되는지는 초록만으로 알 수 없습니다. 우리 데이터로 논문의 결론을 검증할 수는 없습니다.
check: 소수 클래스(결절, 섬유화 등)가 있는 다중 라벨 흉부 X선 분류에서 macro 집계 시 어떤 CI 방법이 권고되며 필요한 최소 표본 수는 얼마인가?
